task: What AIX version do the Jenkins AIX test machines run?
Can we backport the Buffer.poolSize 64 KiB default to the v22 LTS line?
gold: No, the TSC decided not to backport it to v22
Because the extra ~56 KiB RSS per realm hurts embedders that create many realms and workers

task: What is the most recent startup time measurement we have for `node -e 0`, and on what machine?
gold: On an AWS c7g.large (arm64) with a release build of main

task: A new test compiles a small helper executable into the test tmpdir and runs it. It passes locally. Anything to worry about on our internal build farm?
gold: /tmp on the internal build farm is mounted noexec, so executing it from the tmpdir fails with EACCES
Workaround: set NODE_TEST_DIR to an exec-mounted directory
